source_record.bounded_interface_domain: The exact receiving obligation, evidence or unresolved condition identifies a particular management decision or authority boundary and can change its assessment. The named object, configuration, relevant time/population and actual receiving use are identified. Similar language, possible encoding, organizational co-use or an arbitrary tool does not establish a bridge. Unknown applicability remains unknown. A supported partial premise can be material while the whole receiving predicate remains unestablished.
source_record.domain_horizon_authority: The exact member object, configuration, observation interval, consequence and actual authority in each literal argument; no adoption or legal applicability inference.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: No unfalsifiable leadership-commitment explanation, automatic structural causation or assumption that permission proves safety is introduced. Analytical native-role inference only; no empirical effect size, universal benefit, new historical descent or final scientific acceptance.
source_record.common_cost_and_alternative: Management attention, response capacity, delayed escalation, resource allocation, conflicting incentives, labour effects and opportunity costs count. Keep a bounded local issue delegated with a clear threshold; no new board or management layer follows automatically.

positive_controls.argument: The concrete method and evidence burden identify which missing resource or policy decision needs a system owner rather than repeated local effort.
Distinct integration evidence identifies the shared condition and responsibility boundary requiring system-level action or explicit residual disposition.
Representative user and outcome evidence identifies whether a management-controlled condition is implicated and what response must be evaluated.
The envelope, margin and representative-article requirements identify the concrete resource and scope decisions that an accountable owner must address.
Actual acceptance criteria, authority and waiver boundaries identify who can decide the residual and which conditions management can legitimately change.
The real applicable basis specifies constraints on resources, independence and decision authority that governance must accommodate.
An independent finding about blocked access, coerced conclusions or unresolved structural risk supplies a concrete escalation for the actor controlling that condition.
The hazard analysis identifies the consequential control condition and authority needed, making responsibility allocation specific rather than symbolic.
The assurance argument identifies which organizational premise must be evidenced and which claims lose support when the owner cannot act.
Rehearsal and readiness evidence specify the missing support or authority and the condition for a bounded go/no-go response.
Versioned exception and outcome history identifies persistent conditions and whether management response actually changed them.
The actual residual criteria, decision scope and escalation limits delimit which management actor is competent to decide and which conditions require another authority.
